owner_constraints: No D1-D9 rewriting, no T5 changes
Method lookup is a query, method invocation is a separate authority

abi.return: the exact registered method object, or NIL when absent and errorp=false
abi.error: required-specializer arity mismatch always errors; no match errors if errorp=true; control/error dispatch belongs to D2
abi.effect: read-only method-registry query; MUST NOT call body or invoke applicable methods

independent_semantic_argument: DEFGENERIC and DEFMETHOD mutate definitions; APPLICABLE-METHODS returns applicable methods for runtime argument evidence; FIND-METHOD retrieves a single identity by an exact signature even if the method is inapplicable to an alternative runtime subclass. It is not a bare alias for either operation.
positive_witnesses: register primary and before method for same specializer; exact qualifier lookup returns distinct method identities without invocation
with method registered for BASE, query exact CHILD specializer yields NIL with errorp=false although BASE method is applicable to CHILD at runtime
method registration order permutations preserve returned identity for a fixed exact signature
negative_falsifiers: wrong qualifier or reversed ordered qualifier sequence must never retrieve a different method
wrong required-specializer arity raises error, even when errorp=false
no matching signature raises error by default, returns NIL only when errorp=false
read-only lookup must never execute a method body
returned method ID must be the stored method object, not a synthetic applicable-method plan
